capability.databaseDescription: Scheduled tasks will become available after the upgrade. Try again later.
capability.disabledDescription: Scheduled tasks are not enabled in this environment. Contact an administrator.
capability.clusterDescription: Scheduled tasks will become available when all services are ready. Try again later.
capability.unavailableDescription: Refresh the page and try again later.
capability.errorDescription: Scheduled tasks are unavailable to protect your data. Refresh the page and try again later.

confirm.deleteTask: Deleting stops future scheduling and cannot be undone
confirm.createRun: This creates a separate run record. Pausing the task prevents future triggers; it does not cancel active runs.
confirm.forceCancelDescription: The executor may be offline. Force cancel ends this run immediately and cannot be undone.
confirm.deleteArtifact: Deletion cannot be undone. A file with the same name can be uploaded again.

create.title: New scheduled task
create.docPauseNote: Tasks with documents are first created as paused, then automatically enabled once the document upload succeeds; if the upload fails, the task stays paused with a notice.
create.noWorkflow: no SDLC workflow (uses scheduling instructions directly)
create.uploadFailed: Task saved as paused; requirement document upload failed. Retry the upload in task details before enabling it.
create.uploadFailedReason: Task saved as paused; requirement document upload failed: {{reason}}. Retry the upload in task details before enabling it.
create.enableFailed: Requirement documents uploaded, but enabling failed. The task is still paused; retry enabling it in task details.
create.enableFailedReason: Requirement documents uploaded, but enabling failed: {{reason}}. The task is still paused; retry enabling it in task details.

workitems.triggeredReason: The schedule has already triggered and cannot be changed

schedule.cronHelp: Second minute hour day month weekday · Time zone {{tz}} (fixed)
schedule.previewInvalid: Enter a valid expression to see the next 5 runs

policyNote.isolated: Each run uses a fresh session
policyNote.continuous: Continues the session context of the previous run
policyNote.skip: No new trigger while the previous run is active
policyNote.queue: Runs after the previous run finishes
policyNote.allow: Multiple runs can execute at the same time
policyNote.skipAll: All triggers missed during downtime are skipped
policyNote.fireLatest: Only the most recent missed trigger is run
policyNote.fireAll: Each missed trigger is run in turn
